title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E01 — Alpine Lamb Ribs from Siddoway Sheep Company
Jess joins the lamb-raising Siddoway family as they begin sorting the animals that are ready for processing. She then returns to the lodge, where she demonstrates how to prepare and grill lamb ribs.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S02 E06 — Backyard Cabrito Asado in Texas
Jess joins her friend Javi in his backyard, where he welds custom cooking contraptions, including an asado cross they use to cook cabrito together.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E02 — Smoked Elk Sandwiches at Juniper Mountain Ranch
Jess and her friend Shaundi Campbell meet up with guides from Juniper Mountain Ranch in southeastern Idaho to cull an elk for her smoked elk sandwiches.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E08 — Live Fire Venison Backstrap in Oklahoma
With the help of a local Oklahoma guide, Jess sets out to hunt an axis deer, then shares butchery techniques and prepares a delicious backstrap grilled over live fire.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E07 — Oklahoma's Wild Hog Sausage Roll
Jess heads to Oklahoma, where she takes aim at one of the state's estimated 1.5 million feral hogs. Then, she makes a wild hog sausage roll with jalapeño and cheddar.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E06 — Nashville Hot Dove Sliders at Redstone Ranch
Jess and her husband Chris head to their favorite hunting grounds, Redstone Ranch, situated in the heart of the migratory dove flyway.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S02 E05 — Texas A&M Meat Science Experiment
In windy Canyon, Texas, Jess visits West Texas A&M, where she interacts with a cloned cow, participates in a blind meat tasting experiment, and helps teach us how to break down a carcass into the cuts we see in the grocery store.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S02 E01 — Whole Hog BBQ with Pitmaster Pat Martin
Jess teams up with legendary West Tennessee pitmaster and whole hog expert Pat Martin to cook a hog overnight and enjoy a special cut of beef from Australia.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S02 E03 — Braving Wisconsin's Cannibal Sandwich
Jess embarks on a road trip across Wisconsin with her good friend Kaitlin, stopping for a cannibal sandwich and a famous sausage from Usinger's in Milwaukee.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E05 — Fort Worth Barbacoa Feast
Jess and her good friends, Fort Worth pitmaster Joe Riscky and Chef Juan Rodriguez, prepare a traditional barbacoa feast.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S02 E08 — Fall Turkey Hunting with a Texas Game Warden
It's not every day that you get to hunt alongside a game warden, but for this trip, Jess does just that when she meets up with her friend Chris to do some fall turkey hunting.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E02 — Live Fire Whole Trout
Pat Martin heads to the Cherokee National Forest for a day of fly-fishing with an old friend, and to cook up their fresh catch over the campfire.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E04 — The Secret to Texas-Style Smoked Brisket
Pat and his buddy Leonard Botello use the flavors of the beloved native Post Oak to smoke a perfect Central Texas-style beef brisket.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E06 — Greek Spit Roast Lamb
Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E04 — Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps
Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E01 — Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville
Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E02 — Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee
Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E09 — Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish
Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E03 — Barbecued Pork Steak
Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E07 — South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins
When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E08 — Red Curry Braised Pork with Mustard Greens
Pat Martin is in the frozen tundra of Minnesota to visit his new friend, Chef Yia Vang. They brave the cold and break nearly-frozen ground to barbecue a pig's head in the earth.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E10 — Santa Maria Style Sirloin Steak
Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E07 — Spearfishing off Florida's Emerald Coast
Pat travels to the Emerald Coast of Destin, Florida, to join his friend Adam Evans on a spearfishing adventure, sourcing fresh fish to cook over live fire.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E04 — Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps
Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E01 — West Tennessee Whole Hog
Pat Martin teams up with fellow pitmasters to showcase the rugged and nuanced tradition of whole-hog cooking, West Tennessee-style.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E05 — Uncovering Houston BBQ's Asian Influences
Pat meets the trio behind Blood Bros BBQ to discover how three childhood friends seamlessly blended their Asian-American culture with the Texas barbecue traditions they grew up with.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E06 — Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs
Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E05 — Pit-Cooked Chicken with Alabama White Sauce
Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E03 — The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs
Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E04 — Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata
Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E02 — Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia
Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E01 — Best of Salina's Land and Sea
Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E03 — Making Pizza in Naples
Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E05 — Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E07 — Fast Paced Roman Recipes
Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E08 — Italian Alps Comfort Food
Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E06 — Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E04 — Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata
Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E02 — Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E08 — An Eggplant Burger, Seared Salmon, & Squash Casserole!
Jamie shares three easy one-pan wonders: an aubergine burger, sesame salmon, and chickpea & squash casserole!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E04 — Not Your Nonna's Gnocchi and Meatballs
In this episode Jamie takes midweek meals up a notch, knocking out a flavour-packed, simple gnocchi supper and giant spicy meatballs full of delicious time-saving cheats, and turns a family favourite on its head with his upside-down fish pie.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E06 — Jamie's Outrageously Good Pulled Pork
Jamie cooks two one-pan recipes that are ideal for busy lives: his take on shakshuka with asparagus, broccoli & harissa; and an outrageously good pulled pork that can be batched up, frozen and used in loads of meals whenever you're ready.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E07 — Salmon Pasta, a Loaded Burger, and Sticky Toffee Apple Buns!
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes: smoked salmon pasta, a loaded beef burger, and sticky toffee apple buns.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Roast Lamb and Eggplant
Jamie kicks off his new one-pan series with a simplified and delicious frying-pan pasta, a clever twist on a fish pie that's full of flavour with none of the fuss, and a sublime roast lamb feast with a fantastic hack to speed up cooking.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E03 — Crispy Rolled Pork Belly and Risotto
Jamie shares more fabulous one-pan dishes: foolproof tray-baked salmon in a bag; super-easy tomato fritters that you can rattle out in a frying pan; and roasted rolled pork and a risotto that are BOTH cooked in the same casserole pan. Result!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E05 — Sweet Potato Chilli and Homemade Nachos
Jamie shows us a delicious range of one-pan dishes: a super-speedy smashed lemongrass chicken; flavour-packed sweet potato chilli with homemade nachos; and a chocolate party tray cake with retro tinned-mandarin and buttercream filling.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E02 — Peperonata Pasta
Elevated pasta doesn't need to be complicated or expensive. Chef Frankie Celenza makes Peperonata Pasta with just 5 ingredients. Plus, how to properly store sauce for a future meal.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E18 — Layer-less Seven Layer Salad
Chef Frankie Celenza goes rogue with his take on a classic mid-western dish: the 7 Layer Salad.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E06 — Meatloaf More Than Once
Chef Frankie Celenza turns 2 lbs of ground beef into a moist meatloaf and pan-seared meatloaf burgers with slaw. Plus, a tip on storing burgers that your future self will thank you for.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E14 — Herby Butter Blackened Catfish
Chef Frankie Celenza whips up a lemon-herb compound butter that's great on everything, then uses it to sear coffee-rubbed blackened catfish. Freeze extras into flavor coins for months of easy flavor! Because everything is better with butter.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E07 — Soba So Good
What's better than hot noodles on a hot day? Cold noodles on a hot day! Chef Frankie Celenza whips up a luxury lunch at home: cold soba noodles in homemade kombu dashi with seared mushrooms. Plus, a savvy storage tip for optimal leftovers.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E08 — Pantry Pasta E Fagioli
Chef Frankie Celenza whips up cozy Pasta e Fagioli from pantry staples, turning simple beans and pasta into a soup or stew that tastes like Nonna made it. This recipe is the ultimate way to clean out your fridge and pantry.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E11 — Spam Gyro Hero
Canned Spam to the rescue. Chef Frankie Celenza turns the humble shelf-stable pantry item into crispy, Mediterranean-spiced gyro meat, served in quick 20-minute pitas with homemade tzatziki. Plus, a lesson on homemade spice blends.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E16 — Half Homemade Matzo Ball Soup
Chef Frankie Celenza makes cozy, comforting Matzo Ball Soup entirely from scratch, almost. Rotisserie chicken is the struggle hero of this classic recipe, searing the skin to create rich schmaltz. Plus homemade matzo balls that float and never sink.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E10 — Pub-Style Pie
A comforting pub classic made easy. Chef Frankie Celenza turns inexpensive chuck roast and rich stout beer into a hearty British Beef and Ale Pie with a waterproof hot water crust. Plus, how to cook once for comfort food twice.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E04 — Liver, Liver, Ragu Dinner
Chef Frankie makes a rich, silky ragù using an often misunderstood ingredient: chicken liver. Plus, how to stretch your meat with more meat.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E09 — Ramen Croutons and Napa Cabbage
Chef Frankie Celenza elevates a packet of ramen for a hearty yet dainty salad. The dish features crispy croutons atop a crunchy napa cabbage with fruit, nuts and leftover chicken. Plus, a reminder to make your own salad dressing. You can do it!

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E01 — BEC for One, For Many
Make the perfect bacon, egg and cheese sandwich for yourself or for a crowd with Chef Frankie Celenza's tips on homemade condiments and the secret to crispy bacon every time.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E17 — A Big Braised Chuck Roast Sandwich aka The Wichita
Have you ever wondered what's the difference between a Philly Cheesesteak and a French Dip Sandwich? Chef Frankie Celenza takes a bite out of both and invents a whole new, affordable, delicious sandwich: The Wichita!

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S10 E15 — Frozen Broccoli, Bechamel, Mac, and Cheese
Fancy meets frozen with this easy meal the whole family will love. Chef Frankie Celenza makes Broccoli Mac & Cheese with a roux-based béchamel and frozen broccoli. Plus, a tip before you throw away that Parmesan cheese rind.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E01 — 4th of July BBQ Celebration!
Kevin & Noah celebrate the 4th of July with a supersized barbecue menu including whole hog BBQ, lobster mac'n cheese, Texas-style char dogs, tri-tip and pinto beans.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E04 — Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E03 — Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat
Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E02 — The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E05 — The Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye
It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E01 — Beef Shank is the New Brisket
Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E03 — Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed
It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E04 — These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E05 — The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need
Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E04 — Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella
Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel!
Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture
Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird
Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots
Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook
Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E04 — Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella
Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

description:
S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch
Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating
Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw
Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E04 — Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E01 — Not Your Nonna's Risotto
Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E04 — Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread
Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils
Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips
Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E05 — Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E03 — Sesame Chicken Burger and Surf & Turf Mixed Grill
Jamie takes outdoor cooking to new heights with his Ultimate Barbecue Breakfast, a smoke-kissed Sesame Chicken Burger, his Veggie Barbecue Mezze offering an epic spread; and his Surf & Turf Mixed Grill is a perfect party crowd-pleaser!

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E02 — Grilled Fish Tacos and a Veggie Pancake
For the ultimate BBQ experience, Jamie cooks a Butterflied Leg of Lamb, his Spiced Chicken Kebabs and creamy butter sauce perfect for a party, followed by Grilled Fish Tacos and Jamie's Tear 'n' Share Veggie Pancake ready to feed a crowd.

title: Jamie Oliver's Ultimate BBQ
description:
S01 E01 — Grilled Steak Salad and Italian-style Lamb Chops
Jamie shares his perfect Steak & Chargrilled Salad, a Chicken Caesar Salad with an upgrade on the bars, Italia-inspired Sizzling Lamb Lollipops and his delicious Whole Barbecue Fish & Ratatouille to upgrade your grill skills!

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E01 — 4th of July BBQ Celebration!
Kevin & Noah celebrate the 4th of July with a supersized barbecue menu including whole hog BBQ, lobster mac'n cheese, Texas-style char dogs, tri-tip and pinto beans.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E05 — The Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye
It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E03 — Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed
It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E04 — Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E01 — Beef Shank is the New Brisket
Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.
